prep.label: Check your card
prep.text: Use a Fargo Public Library account in good standing.

prep.label: Confirm pickup and due date
prep.text: The meter can be borrowed from all three library locations for up to three weeks. Check timing with the branch.

operators.name: Norfolk Public Library Energy Detective Kit

prep.label: Choose a listed branch
prep.text: The city lists Jordan-Newby, Mary D. Pretlow, Slover and Richard A. Tucker for this kit.

prep.label: Check your card and return location
prep.text: The equipment page calls for an adult Norfolk card and an in-person return at the checkout branch. Ask the branch for the current loan period.

operators.name: Fairfax County Public Library Conserve Kit

prep.label: Hold the Conserve Kit
prep.text: Check the official catalog for pickup before you travel.

prep.label: Return the reusable tools inside
prep.text: The library accepts the kit inside any branch. Pack the reusable parts and leftover consumable supplies according to the kit instructions.

operators.name: Vancouver Public Library Kill A Watt EZ

prep.label: Check the card type
prep.text: The device page requires a Vancouver Public Library card with less than $10 in outstanding charges. It also lists excluded card types, including Juvenile and BC OneCard.

prep.label: Open the catalog entry
prep.text: Follow the Kill A Watt EZ catalog link for the item's branch availability.

prep.label: Check your device
prep.text: Kent lists iOS 18 or Android 14 or later, Bluetooth and the FLIR ONE app. Check the current requirements before pickup.

prep.label: Sign and return in the same place
prep.text: Sign the lending agreement at collection and return to the branch that issued the camera.

prep.label: Reserve through the catalog
prep.text: Joondalup lists the kits at all city libraries. Check the selected pickup's availability.

prep.label: Bring both forms of identification
prep.text: Bring photo ID and your library card. The city's instructions describe how to join if you need a library membership.

prep.label: Tell staff which device matters
prep.text: Ask about the optional Power Mate Lite when reserving your kit.

prep.label: Return to the pickup branch
prep.text: Hand the kit to staff during opening hours. The library excludes the returns chute.

prep.label: Choose a participating library
prep.text: Check the catalog for City, Mosgiel, Port Chalmers, Blueskin Bay or Waikouaiti.

prep.label: Use the supplied record booklet
prep.text: The kit includes operating instructions and a booklet to record observations. Standard library charges can apply to missing or lost kits.

tasks.label: Reserve the tool or kit before pickup

rules.text: The library lists Kill A Watt electricity monitors at all three branches. The loan is up to three weeks for a library account in good standing.
The city mentions holds and requests in its renewal rule. Ask the branch how to request this item and where you can collect it.
The city describes tools for checking appliance energy use. Ask the branch to confirm the plug-in meter and its instructions.
The city describes instruments for finding drafts and heat loss. Ask whether the current kit includes a camera that produces a heat image.
Confirm the model of the heat-loss instrument with the branch if you need a single-point infrared reading.
The city links the catalog item. Ask whether you can place a hold and confirm the pickup branch before going.
The Conserve Kit lists a kilowatt usage meter for individual plug-in devices.
The Conserve Kit inventory lists a spot thermometer. Check Fairfax's separate Thermal Cameras collection for a heat image.
Fairfax identifies the IRT206 in the kit as a simple spot thermometer.
Place a Conserve Kit hold from the library's page. The kit loan is two weeks.
The cataloged loan device is the P4460 Kill A Watt EZ. Check your card type and account status before borrowing.
Open the item's catalog record from the device page. Ask the library about holds, eligible pickup and the current loan period.
Participating libraries lend a FLIR ONE Edge for up to seven days. Members must be aged 16 or over and use a compatible phone or tablet.
Choose a participating branch and join its waiting list with your library card number, either in person or through the council's listed contact routes.
The kit inventory includes a power monitor.
The kit inventory includes a thermal camera. Check the kit documentation for the current equipment and setup.
Use the library catalog to reserve a seven-day loan. Bring photo ID and your library card to borrow.
Only some kits have the Power Mate Lite. Ask the pickup branch to check your exact kit before you go.
The library lists a FLIR TG165-X thermal camera in each Energy Saver Kit.
A separate thermometer is listed without a model. Confirm whether it is the type you need.
Members can use the reserve link for Ballarat, Sebastopol or Wendouree. Check that the exact kit contains the tools you need.
The two-week HEAT Kit includes a meter for plug-in appliances.
The listed HEAT Kit inventory includes an infrared thermometer for surface readings. Ask the library about a separate camera loan if you need a heat image.
The HEAT Kit includes an infrared thermometer for checking surface temperature.
Check the catalog. Dunedin lists no charge to place a hold and a two-week loan for library members.
